    "Independently checked the complete 15-path difference and all 1,483 tracked objects and executable modes in a clean detached checkout. No overall source-admission, protected website, release, attachment, Core database, Feedback or brand object changed. The native delta changes capture eligibility and existing text/status projections, without requesting system grants or touching an installation.",
    "Built the actual Core and Capture targets on ARM64 using Apple Swift 6.4. Replayed both the control and the exact earlier atomic-substitution witness against the new objects. The substitution actually fired. Both runs imported zero foreign assets and preserved the original fixture bytes.",
    "A separate process-local witness substituted two actual directories at fdopendir, after opening and checking the retiring directory but before reading its entries. Both directories contained a valid same-named screenshot. The normal service imported exactly one row with the authorized original occurrence identity and matching private bytes; the replacement occurrence, symlink, dot file, Finder-invisible file and FIFO did not enter history. The no-swap control had the same correct row. No fixtures were taken from user data.",
    "An initially unreadable neighboring screenshot left the departure recoverable while the readable original was collected. After restoring read access to that one synthetic file, normal reconciliation yielded both original identities, no foreign row and no outstanding departure. A legacy v2 departure without directory identity recovered only its recorded file and retained the unresolved departure without enumerating unrecorded files.",
    "Exercised actual Foundation bookmark and CaptureService source with isolated in-memory preferences and test directories. Recreating the selected path stopped its watcher and imported zero assets without changing the old bookmark. An unrelated unselected directory remained eligible for ordinary checks. Explicitly selecting the replacement produced one private copy with matching bytes; malformed bookmark bytes were preserved. Reviewed the wake, parent-event, rescan and recheck entry points, which revalidate before the affected reads.",
    "All 46 consumer bindings matched their tracked blobs and SHA-256 digests at the new checkpoint and its declared binding baseline. The preceding 43-entry file was archived byte-for-byte. The existing consumer checker passed 106/106. The privacy delta is design only: it binds identity at confirmation, preserves ambiguous partial moves, and freezes old destructive authority after restoring into a different root. No deletion action, upload, public package, or permission reset was added."
  ],
